ky: n a state in east central United States; a border state during the American Civil War; famous for breeding race horses
kylie: n. an Australian boomerang; one side flat and the other convex
kymograph: n. scientific instrument consisting of a rotating drum holding paper on which a stylus traces a continuous record (as of breathing or blood pressure)
kyoto: n. a city in central Japan on southern Honshu; a famous cultural center that was once the capital of Japan
kyushu: n. the southernmost of the four main islands of Japan; contains coal fields
